name: TC01_normal_bet
description: A direct bet at exactly the minimum threshold, inside the open betting window, is accepted and recorded.

name: TC02_normal_claim
description: A winning bettor claims after settlement; payout is total pool minus 2% fee, split proportional to the winning side's total.

name: TC03_agent_bet_replay
description: Submitting the identical attestation a second time is rejected even though the first submission succeeded.

name: TC04_attestation_expired
description: An attestation submitted at or after its expiry timestamp is rejected.

name: TC05_signer_mismatch
description: An attestation signed by a key other than the authorized signer is rejected, regardless of otherwise-valid contents.

outcome.reason: attestation not signed by authorized signer

name: TC06_amount_below_minimum
description: A direct bet one wei below the minimum threshold is rejected.

name: TC07_amount_above_agent_cap
description: An agent bet one wei above the agent-specific cap is rejected.

name: TC08_duplicate_bet
description: The same address betting twice on the same market is rejected on the second attempt, regardless of direction.

outcome.reason: address already bet on this market

name: TC09_tie_settlement
description: When the settlement price exactly equals the lock price, BULL is declared the winner.

name: TC10_fee_accumulation
description: Each successful claim adds that bet's proportional share of the 2% fee to the global accumulated-fees counter.

name: TC11_withdraw_success
description: Admin withdraws a non-zero accumulated-fees balance; the counter resets to zero.

name: TC12_withdraw_zero_fails
description: Admin attempting to withdraw when the accumulated-fees counter is zero is rejected.

name: TC13_state_order_enforced
description: OPEN -> LOCKED -> SETTLED cannot be skipped or repeated (bonus check, not in the required list).

inputs.attempted: settle before lock, and lock twice

result.settle_before_lock: rejected: market must be LOCKED to settle
result.lock_twice: rejected: market must be OPEN to lock

name: TC14_multi_bettor_payout_consistency
description: With multiple winners of different bet sizes, sum(payouts) + accumulated_fees never exceeds the total pool (bonus check, not in the required list).

name: TC15_agent_bet_full_flow
description: An agent places a winning bet via place_agent_bet, the market settles, and the agent itself successfully claims; payout and fee-share match the same formula used for human claims.

name: TC16_mixed_human_agent_same_direction
description: A human and an agent both bet BULL on the same market (a third bettor bets BEAR and loses); bull_total correctly aggregates both sources into one pool, and both claimants receive the same proportional payout.

name: TC17_mixed_human_agent_opposite_direction
description: A human bets BULL and an agent bets BEAR on the same market; when BULL wins, the human claims correctly from the shared pool and the agent's losing claim is rejected.

name: TC18_agent_duplicate_bet_different_attestation
description: The same agent address betting twice on the same market via two DIFFERENT attestations is rejected by the duplicate-bet check, not the attestation-replay check.

inputs.note: two distinct attestations for the same agent+market, not a replay of the same one

result.second_bet_rejected_reason: address already bet on this market

name: TC19_tie_full_claim_flow
description: A tie (settle_price == lock_price) settles as a BULL win end-to-end: the BULL bettor successfully claims and the BEAR bettor's claim is rejected.
